payload.content: Hermes config.yaml is security-protected: patch/write_file tools refuse to edit it. Must use `hermes config set <key> <value>` for all config changes. Arrays/objects use JSON syntax: `hermes config set custom_providers '[{"name": "abacus-ai", ...}]'`.
